name: Toggle group
description: Pressed buttons and segmented controls for toolbar state, display modes, and compact choices.

Toggle.description: A standalone two-state button. Use it for toolbar actions such as formatting or compact view toggles.

variant.description: Pressed-state treatment. Default uses a soft surface; solid uses the primary color; ghost stays quiet.

size.description: Density. Every size keeps at least a 44px touch target.

children.description: Short label or icon. Icon-only toggles need aria-label.

ToggleGroup.description: Shared state wrapper for related toggle items.

type.description: Single allows one pressed item; multiple allows any number of pressed items.

value.description: Controlled value. Use a string for single groups and string[] for multiple groups.

defaultValue.description: Initial uncontrolled value. Use a string for single groups and string[] for multiple groups.

onValueChange.description: Called when group value changes. Single groups receive a string; multiple groups receive a string array.

variant.description: Default item variant inherited by ToggleGroupItem children.

size.description: Default item size inherited by ToggleGroupItem children.

width.description: Whether the group hugs content or lets items share available width.

ToggleGroupItem.description: A toggle button participating in a ToggleGroup.

value.description: Value submitted to the parent ToggleGroup.

variant.description: Optional override for this item. Prefer the group-level variant.

size.description: Optional override for this item. Prefer the group-level size.

children.description: Short label or icon. Icon-only items need aria-label.

forbidden: Do not use ToggleGroup to switch content panels; use Tabs.
Do not use ToggleGroup for filtering a collection; use Pill.
Do not use standalone Toggle for persisted binary settings; use Switch.
Do not use ToggleGroup when native radio inputs are required for form submission; use Radio group once available.
Do not let segmented labels wrap across multiple lines.

responsive.note: Every Toggle and ToggleGroupItem size keeps at least a 44px touch target. Use width="full" for short form choices on mobile.
